name: Jones Construction Company Ltd.
brand_truth: A Nassau building contractor, built from the block up, working out of Airport Industrial Park.

design.signature: R3F block building assembling course by course with tower crane; sticky section-drawing scrollytelling

current_site_findings: No website: the only result is a directory listing with a stock picture, a phone number and the words construction consultants.
Search results mix the company up with a US contractor, an Abaco builder and a roofing firm.
Nothing online says what you build or how to start a project.
No email or project form for developers and procurement officers abroad.
Google has no business details to place you in Airport Industrial Park.
pitch_line: Right now a developer who Googles Jones Construction finds a US firm and a directory stub; this site shows them, in one screen, that you build in block and steel in Nassau and lets them brief you in one call.
assumptions: Service lines: new homes and commercial buildings, additions and renovations, storm damage repairs, site supervision, sequencing of trades, project review, advice on stalled work
Four-stage build process copy is category standard
Still operating at Airport Industrial Park on 242-327-7486
notes: No photos, email, hours or projects found; hero and drawings are illustrations. MD named as Mervin Jones in 2004 press (not used on site). Be aware: Tribune 2014 article criticised the company over a 2009 NIB building contract; not referenced on the site. Proposed domain jonesconstructionbahamas.com (unverified availability). Fonts and the 3D scene render only online (sandbox QA used fallbacks).
